text: Resolved the sequencing decision in favor of a deliberate curated slurm4s-core facade, not a 610-error mechanical migration. These kernel types appear throughout slurm4s public signatures; requiring consumers to import the implementation-owner package would degrade API ergonomics without changing semantics. SharedKernel.scala now states a narrow inclusion rule (only kernel types in public slurm4s API), ADR 0010 and compatibility.md record the aliases as supported source surface, and SharedKernelFacadeSuite proves exact bidirectional type identity plus companion delegation. Provider-neutral code still imports remote-exec-kernel directly. Verified core/test (147 tests) and scalafmtCheckAll.
